title: Roles and Responsibilities Matrix
instructions: Confirm each proposed owner and add a deputy for critical roles. One person may hold more than one role in a small organisation.

rows.responsibilities: Provide direction, approve policy, resources, risk acceptance and management review decisions.
rows.authority: Approve management-system decisions and major exceptions.

rows.responsibilities: Coordinate templates, actions, evidence, audits, reviews and improvements.
rows.authority: Assign work and escalate overdue or high-risk issues.

rows.responsibilities: Coordinate security risks, controls, incidents and awareness.
rows.authority: Require security treatment and escalate unacceptable risk.

rows.responsibilities: Coordinate processing records, rights requests, DPIAs, breaches and privacy advice.
rows.authority: Stop or escalate processing that creates unmanaged privacy risk.

rows.responsibilities: Coordinate process performance, complaints, nonconformities and improvement.
rows.authority: Require corrective action for quality failures.

rows.responsibilities: Coordinate aspects, obligations, objectives, incidents and performance monitoring.
rows.authority: Escalate significant environmental risk or non-compliance.

rows.responsibilities: Coordinate AI inventory, impact assessment, risk, oversight and monitoring.
rows.authority: Pause or escalate AI use that exceeds approved risk.
